title: RTPS: Fix builtin type dissection and add secure TypeLookup entity IDs
description:
Update the InstanceStateDataResponse builtin type dissection to match
the final RTI Connext specification: rename InstanceTransitionData to
InstanceUpdateData, remove the SerializedKey member (element count 4
to 3), rename NtpTime_t to RTPSTime_t with uint32 fields instead of
int32, and rename transition_sequence_number to update_sequence_number.

Fix writer_gid/reader_gid typos in the InstanceStateDataResponse member
names (should be writer_guid/reader_guid).

Add the secure TypeLookup Service entity IDs (0xff0300c3, 0xff0300c4,
0xff0301c3, 0xff0301c4) to the entity_id value_string table, the
writerId abbreviation switch, and all four TypeLookup request/reply
dissection checks in dissect_serialized_data. Previously, these were
defined as constants but not wired into the dissection logic.

AI-Assisted: yes (GitHub Copilot, Claude)
